data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Mindbox push notifications, in‑app messages and event tracking.
data.what_it_does: Provides a wrapper around the native Mindbox SDKs for Android and iOS. Allows sending client events to Mindbox and handling push and in‑app messages. Exposes initialization and operation APIs from Dart.
use_when: You need to integrate Mindbox’s push‑notification and in‑app‑message platform into a Flutter app
You already use Mindbox as your backend for marketing communications
avoid_when: You require a cross‑platform solution that also works on web or desktop
You prefer a fully open‑source push‑notification stack
strengths: Simple wrapper around official native SDKs
Keeps native SDK versions in sync with the Flutter package
Supports both Android and iOS out of the box
weaknesses: Only works with Mindbox services, no alternative providers
Documentation largely points to external sites
data.setup_notes: Add mindbox, mindbox_android and mindbox_ios to pubspec. Follow Mindbox docs to add required permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and iOS Info.plist, and initialize the SDK in native Android/iOS code.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides cross‑platform push notifications with extensive documentation and web support
